newsitem.title: UK: Porvair makes gloomy trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Porvair makes gloomy trading statement.

text.p: Footwear and textiles manufacturer Porvair Plc said on Tuesday that pretax profit for the year to November 30, 1996 was unlikely to exceed 4.2 million stg.
The group said that over the last two months sales and profit in four of its six companies were significantly lower than anticipated and this trend had continued in November.

It said the main reason for the shortfall in profits was lower trading levels. This situation has been compounded by its decision to accelerate investment during the second half in the market development programme for Comfort Barrier Systems.
Porvair said that this investement would lead to increased sales in the coming year.
The company released annual results in January showing pretax profits of 5.1 million stg for the year to November 30, 1995, compared with 3.1 million previously.
Porvair said in a statement, "The underlying strength of the business is intact and the future continues to look promising despite these short term difficulties."
By 0859 GMT, shares in the company had lost 82-1/2p to 182-1/2.
